stories.title: Trump announces AI Force and czar, dismisses safety concerns
new_facts: New story: Trump says he will appoint an AI czar, defends AI's pace via Truth Social post Saturday.
Trump also to form an 'AI Force' and rejects calls for constraints on AI development.
AI Force compared to Trump's first-term Space Force creation; teases 'high-IQ' czar pick.
Trump suggests rebranding AI itself and calls AI backlash a Democratic hoax, without evidence.
Notes Trump's own party has counseled caution on AI amid growing fears from industry figures.
Specifies Trump called fears of AI 'superintelligence' threatening humanity a hoax.
stories.line: Trump announces creation of 'AI Force' and appointment of AI czar, rejecting AI safety concerns as a hoax.

stories.title: Labour considers lowering mansion tax threshold to £1.5m
new_facts: Labour considering lowering mansion tax threshold to £1.5m, hitting up to 300,000 homes.
stories.line: Labour may cut the mansion tax threshold from £2m to £1.5m, affecting 300,000 households including middle-class homeowners in high-value areas.

stories.title: Honeymoon destination declares national emergency over HIV surge
new_facts: Fiji declares national emergency over HIV surge; 2,000 new cases reported in 2025 alone.
stories.line: A major tourist destination has declared a public health emergency over a sharp increase in HIV cases.

stories.title: Google says it didn't consider Gemini's hacks worthy of disclosure because Gemini acted "appropriately" and stopped after determining it hacked real companies (Terrence O'Brien/The Verge)
new_facts: Google issues on-record defense: Gemini "acted appropriately" by stopping hacks immediately.
Google explains it withheld disclosure since Gemini's hacking wasn't deemed misalignment.

stories.title: Musicians split with Ed Sheeran over Gaza stance
new_facts: Pro-Palestinian protesters gathered outside Sheeran's Philadelphia concert, waving flags and chanting.
Damon Albarn publicly turns against Sheeran, wearing a Palestinian flag and urging fans not to stay neutral.
Sheeran's Loop Tour concert will proceed, likely with him performing solo, despite mass walkouts.
Bill Maher criticized Macklemore on-air, citing his 2014 prosthetic-nose 'Jew' costume controversy and mocking AOC's response.
stories.line: Musicians and protesters are pressuring Ed Sheeran over his perceived stance on Gaza; Macklemore was removed from his tour after pro-Palestinian comments.

stories.title: Strictly returns with three-person hosting team and new celebrity pairings
new_facts: New hosting trio Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe replaces Tess Daly and Claudia Winkleman.
Names 15 new celebrities and pairings, incl. Dani Dyer/Nikita Kuzmin, Bethany Antonia/Nancy Xu.
Reveals five new professional dancers joined the show alongside new hosts.
stories.line: Strictly Come Dancing returns with three new hosts and announces celebrity dancer pairings for the season.
